description: mappegis.regione.emilia-romagna.it: coastal flood and storm surge hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappegis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. Coverage: the area served by mappegis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about coastal flood and storm surge hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: DBTR2013 - Linea di costa marina - (COS_GLI); Linea di Costa - Linea di costa 1998; Linea di Costa - Linea di costa 2011; Linea di Costa - Linea di costa 2020_OB. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
